main_text.l: תִּשְׁאֲרֽנָה relinquemini, vel eritur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f.f. & 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. שָׁאַר.
תָּשֵׁב reduces, pro תָּשִׁיב, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. שׁוּב.
תֵּשֵׁב habitabis, vel bit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f.f. Rad. יָשַׁב.
תַּשְׁבִּירֵנִי, vel, תַּשְׁבְּרֵנִי vendes mihi, Deut. 2. 28. pro, תַּשְׁפִּיר לִי ; fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. Rad. שָׁבַר.
תַּשְׁבִּית cessare facies, תַּשְׁבִּיתוּ facietis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. & pl. m. Rad. שָׁבַת.
תִּשְׁבֶּךָּ captivum tenebit te, fut. Kal, 3. sing. f. aff. Rad. שָׁבָה.
תָּשְׁבֻּנָה restitueetis, vel ent, pro תָּשִׁבְנָה, fut. Hiph. 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. שׁוּב.
תָּשְׁבֻּנָה, vel תָּשֻׁבְנָה revertemini, vel tur, & pro eo, תָּשְׁבִּינָה, & תָּשְׁבֻּנָה, fut. Kal, 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. שׁוּב.
תִּשְׁבַּע jurabis, vel bit, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f.f. Rad. שָׁבַע.
תִּשְׁבַּר confringes, vel get, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f.f. Rad. שָׁבַר.
תִּשְׁבַּר frangeris, vel tur, pro תִּשָּׁבֵר, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f.f. Rad. שָׁבַר.
תִּשְׁבְּרֶנָּה exspectabitis, fut. Piel, 2. pl. f. Rad. שָׁבַר.
תִּשְׁבֹּת quiesces, vel cet, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f.f. Rad. שָׁבַת.
תִּשְׁגּוּ errabitis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. R. שָׁגָה.
תִּשְׁגֶּיא augebis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. שָׁגָא: vel pro תִּשְׁגֶּה fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. שָׁגָה.
[illegible, ~6 letters] facies ut evescat, Jes. 17. 11. fut. Piel gem.

page.notes: Hebrew forms in the left column near the top and the top-right lines are rendered with best reading; the vowel points are approximate where the scan is blurred. The entry beginning in the left column and continuing into the right column (תָּשְׁבֻּנָה, "fut. Kal, 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. שׁוּב.") is one entry, split by the column break. The Hebrew of the last entry is illegible on the scan. "evescat" and "Jes." are read from a blurred print and may be uncertain.
